title: PartnerTree Overview Tour
description: Administrative interface for managing organizational hierarchy and partner tree structure. Allows viewing, editing, and organizing partner categories and groups in a hierarchical tree format.

popover.title: Welcome to PartnerTreeComponent
popover.description: This page provides the administrative interface for managing your organization's hierarchy and partner tree structure. You can view, edit, and organize partner categories and groups in a hierarchical tree format, allowing for clear visualization and management of your business relationships.

popover.title: New Partner Level
popover.description:
This button opens a dialog to create a new organizational node, such as a category or group, within the partner hierarchy tree. Use this to expand your organizational structure.

When to use: When you need to add a new category or group to your partner hierarchy., When you are setting up a new division or segment within your organization's structure.

popover.title: Tour Complete!
popover.description: You've learned the key features of PartnerTree. You can always restart this tour from the help menu.
